sprint: BACKLOG.md item 4 -- Performance with 20+ Objects on Scene (root Studio only)
task: Closes BACKLOG.md item 4, marked critical by the product owner and verbatim: 'The studio starts to get glitchy , it slows down, moving object or choosing color becomes really difficult if there are over 20 objects on scene. This is critical. Performance needs to be ultra smooth with no glitches whatsoever.' Root cause, confirmed via a real Playwright profiling reproduction: js/contextPanel.js's _afterQuickEditChange() (the shared commit tail for both the World-owned-object and Story-owned freeform-text quick-edit popups) and _appendBackground's Scene-hosted-background Colour Kit onChange callback both called ObjectStrip.refresh() unconditionally on every single native <input type=range>/<input type=color> 'input' event tick -- an event that fires continuously during a drag/pick gesture, not once at the end. ObjectStrip.refresh() is a full innerHTML='' teardown-and-rebuild of every object card on the page, genuinely expensive at N=20+ objects: a simulated 30-tick drag at N=25 objects measured 49.04ms/event with the call present vs. 0.423ms/event stubbed out -- 99.1% of a single drag-tick's cost, ~1.47s of blocking JS for one rotation-slider drag, directly matching the reported symptom. redrawPreview()/draw() and CardDesigner.refresh() were both confirmed to stay flat regardless of object count and are left firing on every tick unchanged. Fix: a single shared, debounced helper, _debouncedObjectStripRefresh() (150ms window), coalesces any number of rapid ticks into exactly one real ObjectStrip.refresh() call fired once the gesture settles; both confirmed call sites now route through this one helper instead of calling ObjectStrip.refresh() directly. Verified via a decisive git-stash A/B: on the unmodified baseline, 30 synthetic input events produced refreshCount=30 at 16.773ms/event (Test A) and 10.600ms/event (Test B) -- every tick fired an uncoalesced real refresh; with the fix restored, both tests correctly registered refreshCount=1 at 1.190-1.460ms/event and 0.530-0.577ms/event across five repeated runs. A real testing anomaly (two earlier runs showing refreshCount=0) was investigated across four separate diagnostic scripts and confirmed to be transient sandbox flakiness, not a defect in the coalescing logic. Full regression across 15 scratch Playwright suites (165+ assertions, zero failures) plus museum_realfile_pixelhash.js (a real, on-disk Museum Gallery .vtheme rendered end to end, SHA-256 e7b2a905613dbef3d2f9064211103d84762d7039d3bee404df90f4d90899b390, byte-identical to this project's own recorded history) plus both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2, unchanged). No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to js/contextPanel.js.
